title: Measuring amplitude and frequency with a CRO

questions.prompt: State the function of (a) the y-gain control and (b) the time-base control of a CRO.
A point on a wave moves between displacements +6.0 mm and -6.0 mm. What is its amplitude?
A CRO trace has a vertical amplitude of 3.5 divisions. The y-gain is 0.20 V div⁻¹. What is the signal amplitude?
One complete cycle occupies 5.0 horizontal divisions. The time-base is 0.40 ms div⁻¹. What is the frequency?
A CRO trace has a vertical amplitude of 2.8 divisions. Its y-gain is 50 mV div⁻¹. Two complete cycles occupy 7.5 horizontal divisions.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Calculate the signal amplitude in volts.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: The time-base is 0.80 ms div⁻¹. Calculate the period of the signal.

questions.prompt: A microphone detects a progressive sound wave and is connected to a CRO. The figure shows four complete trace cycles across 14.4 horizontal divisions. The vertical peak-to-peak height is 5.6 divisions. The y-gain is 0.15 V div⁻¹ and the time-base is 20 μs div⁻¹.

figure.purpose: Assess a mixed multi-cycle CRO measurement while retaining the earlier progressive-wave model.
